notes: Assembler 2.0.1. Text panel: Text · Captions · Sentences. Captions = the captions exactly as on screen: Enter new line, Shift+Enter new caption, «⊕ злити ↓», click a card to select it, right-click ✦ highlight words · ✎ this caption's style (the Style tab edits only it) · 🎨 from a preset; [ / ] word timing. Sentences = voice: 🎙 re-voice (each line cloned from the voice near it), 👄 lips (Sync Lipsync-2-Pro), 📅 Dates (find & replace every spoken date), ✂ cut. ✦ Accent style group (font, italic, size, case, colour, stroke, shadow, plate). ✨ Seedance changes sound + picture by default; Seedance 2.5 Turbo / Flash; ✨ Generated lane to switch pieces on / off. Numbers as digits after transcribe. 🎙 dictation: Scribe + Gemini via WaveSpeed. 💾 save changes into a preset. Punctuation Off / ?! only / All. Redo, timeline zoom, Cmd-drag audio scrub. ⬇ MRTech JSON for presets.
